about: Batch 12 (10 Nov 2026), registered after batch 11 and before any of its own scores. Batch 11 (fast-loop run 42792051707): the race fitted as a book (share) cut the RMSE of log(BSP) from 0.4090 to 0.3849 (-0.0241, z -33.8) and the log-loss by 0.00156 (z -6.3); mix, Huber, all history from 2020 and the baselines did not. Here, on share at a learning rate of 0.08 (batch 11's 0.05 fits took 45-52 minutes): the per-track stretch on top of it (the compression is smaller but still there: short prices +0.23, long -0.47 in log); the figs table of the metrics database (greyhound/pit/figs.py: corrected figures, evidence-aware levels, class in lengths, the market-implied rating), whole, figures only, rating only; the live recipe at the same rate for the like-for-like gap; and share refitted on 1 Sep (two segments) to check the gain survives a refit. The bar, fixed now: a change counts when its paired gain in RMSE of log(BSP) over share08 is 3 bootstrap standard errors (by day) or more and its log-loss is no worse beyond 1 standard error; the window has been read by earlier batches, so a pass goes to a forward test on later days before it is adopted.
